description: HashiCorp Vault is a secrets management, encryption-as-a-service, and PKI tool for securely storing and tightly controlling access to tokens, passwords, certificates, and encryption keys.
name: vault
note: This starts Vault in server mode; you must initialize and unseal it on first run (vault operator init / vault operator unseal). The container's internal API port remains the conventional 8200 even though the host-mapped port is different. For production use, add the IPC_LOCK capability to this container in Portainer's advanced settings to prevent memory from being swapped to disk.
title: HashiCorp Vault
